findings.problem: The guillemets are grammatically safe and the meaning is exact, but this is the only place in the ru catalogue where the 'Actions for {name}' frame quotes the inserted name in an accessible name that receives a FILE name: six sibling values render the same frame unquoted, and the one quoted value inserts a browser page title, not a filename. It is also the one form where an empty insertion is visible: image-actions-menu.tsx:364-366 tests `label != null`, so a markdown image with empty alt text (label={alt}, markdown-image.tsx:90) reaches this key with {name} = '' and renders «» where English renders only a trailing space.
evidence: ru ui.library.menu.asset_actions_label = "Действия с файлом {name}" (unquoted, file name)
ru ui.projects.project_updates.file_actions_for_name = "Действия с файлом {name}" (unquoted, file name, three aria-label call sites)

counter-evidence: ru ui.browser.browser_tab_strip.actions_for = "Действия для «{title}»" quotes a page TITLE; ru ui.common.actions.credential_updated = "Учётные данные «{key}» успешно обновлены" quotes a key
ru guide, Punctuation & typography: "Quotes: «ёлочки» in prose, „лапки“ nested inside them." — an accessible name is product chrome, so the guide does not require the marks here
findings.recommendation_reason: Matches the frame of the six existing ru values, keeps the inserted filename verbatim with no case agreement, and degrades exactly like English (a trailing space) if an empty name ever reaches it.
findings.note: Declared MINOR, not MAJOR: the wording is defensible and a screen reader does not voice the marks. If the translator prefers delimiting filenames, keeping «» is acceptable; record the choice on the row rather than churning the value.
